objects.title: Understanding Communication: Verbal Behavior
objects.description: This course focuses on the behavioral processes in the development of language and communication. Topics include the acquisition and development of listener, speaker, reader, and writer behaviors; the application of theory to instructional practices and treatment; and the implications for empirical research.

objects.title: Research Projects in Behavior Analysis
objects.description: Supervised student activities on behavioral research projects identified on an individual or small-group basis.

objects.title: Internship in Behavior Analysis
objects.description: Supervised off-campus, non-group instruction including behavioral field experiences, practice, or internship. Requirements and assessment will include skills including but not limited to national certification requirements.
